datasets.name: IntelliRehabDS (IRDS)
datasets.annotation: Two independent annotators; reported inter-annotator agreement 88%, with disagreements revisited.
datasets.commercialUse: permitted with attribution under CC BY 4.0; still requires clinical validation for product use
datasets.transferability: partial; Kinect skeleton and projected 2D coordinates require explicit mapping to MediaPipe measurements

datasets.name: KERAAL Low Back Pain Physical Rehabilitation Dataset
datasets.annotation: Rehabilitation-doctor/medical expert annotation; dataset documentation describes multiple annotators and temporal/spatial error localization.
notValidFor: commercial model training without separate permission
datasets.commercialUse: not permitted by default; research/validation only unless separate permission is obtained
datasets.transferability: stronger than Kinect-only datasets for camera-domain research because RGB and 2D pose representations are included

datasets.name: GAITEX
labels: three specific instructed incorrect variants per rehabilitation exercise
datasets.annotation: Execution variants were instructed and then manually inspected by a supervisor; labels represent intended conditions rather than independent clinical quality ratings.
datasets.licenseStatus: verify repository/data-record license before training or redistribution
datasets.commercialUse: blocked until license review is complete
datasets.transferability: partial; useful for learning controlled error signatures but less strong than independent clinician annotation

datasets.name: REHAB24-6
datasets.annotation: Recordings were supervised by a physiotherapist who instructed both correct and incorrect executions.
datasets.transferability: high for research because it includes RGB/2D views similar to the intended camera pipeline

datasets.name: University of Idaho Physical Rehabilitation Movement Data
datasets.annotation: Incorrect repetitions were intentionally performed suboptimally, but individual error severity/type was not independently quantified.
datasets.licenseStatus: verify official dataset terms before redistribution/commercial use
datasets.commercialUse: blocked until dataset-specific terms are verified

datasets.name: KIMORE
datasets.licenseStatus: verify original publisher terms before redistribution or commercial use
datasets.commercialUse: blocked until original terms are verified

datasets.name: ExeCheck
datasets.licenseStatus: verify dataset-specific terms before redistribution or commercial use

datasets.name: University of Liverpool Rehabilitation Exercise Dataset (UL-RED)
notValidFor: correct-vs-incorrect training unless explicit quality labels are available
datasets.commercialUse: blocked until license and label suitability are verified
datasets.transferability: useful as measurement validation data, not primary correctness ground truth

datasets.name: Expert-annotated licensed public video augmentation
modalities: RGB video converted to MediaPipe landmarks
labels: must be independently annotated by qualified reviewers
datasets.licenseStatus: only use videos whose terms permit the intended training use
datasets.transferability: potentially high for camera robustness after expert annotation

priorityOrder: IntelliRehabDS for larger open patient-inclusive correctness training/validation
KERAAL for doctor-annotated error type/body-part/time localization in research
REHAB24-6 for webcam-like 2D cross-view research validation
GAITEX for controlled specific error variants
UL-RED for pose/measurement validation rather than correctness labels
